description: Source code for a PyTorch export utility, including classes and functions for tracing, failure reporting, and exporting models with dynamic shape handling.

classes.name: FailureType
classes.description: Enumeration of different failure types during export, such as missing kernels or data errors.

classes.name: FailureReport
classes.description: Represents a specific failure encountered during export, with methods to print detailed info.

classes.name: DraftExportReport
classes.description: Aggregates failures and export details, providing success status and formatted reports.

classes.name: ExpressionCreatedNode
classes.description: Data structure for tracking created expressions during tracing.

classes.name: LogRecord
classes.description: Handles logging of trace events, including deduplication and counting.

classes.name: CaptureStructuredTrace
classes.description: Custom trace handler for capturing structured trace logs during model export.

methods.name: prettify_stack
methods.description: Formats a stack trace into a readable string with file and line info.

methods.name: prettify_frame_locals
methods.description: Formats local variables and symbols for a frame into a string.

methods.name: get_loc
methods.description: Reads a specific line from a file given filename and line number.
